title: Inventory Management API
objective: Build an API for products, stock quantities, and inventory changes.

milestones.title: Milestone 1: Product and inventory resources
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate product and inventory resources in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 2: Atomic stock adjustments and database constraints
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate atomic stock adjustments and database constraints in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 3: Filtering and low-stock queries
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate filtering and low-stock queries in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

milestones.title: Milestone 4: Role permissions, audit history, and concurrency tests
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate role permissions, audit history, and concurrency tests in the project.
Document the contract and test one failure or boundary case.

required_features: Atomic stock adjustments and database constraints
Role permissions, audit history, and concurrency tests
stretch_features: Add contract validation to CI and detect a breaking change.
Add structured request IDs and useful metrics without logging secrets.
Document a recovery or migration trade-off with alternatives.
tests: Test success, missing-resource, validation, and authorization outcomes.
Test duplicates and concurrent updates where the domain has non-idempotent side effects.
Run tests against a disposable database with deterministic fixtures.
Review public responses and logs for secret or personal-data exposure.
review_method: Automated tests and static contract checks plus human review against the rubric; no arbitrary learner code executes inside CodeLeaf’s production API.
status_note: Unreviewed project draft; validate scope, starter files, rubric and implementation assumptions before publication.
